roles.name: pd_explorer
roles.routing: Focused codebase exploration and evidence gathering.

roles.name: pd_reviewer
roles.routing: Correctness review, regression analysis and missing test coverage.

roles.name: pd_implementer
roles.routing: Bounded implementation from an accepted plan, with assigned file ownership and focused validation.

roles.name: pd_diagnostician
roles.routing: Root-cause investigation, observations versus hypotheses, and the smallest decisive next experiment.

roles.name: pd_transformer
roles.routing: Explicit mechanical edits with a deterministic success condition; return ambiguity to the parent.

roles.name: pd_architecture_adviser
roles.routing: Explicit escalation for difficult architecture tradeoffs or unresolved competing explanations.

installSummary: Implementation and transformation can edit assigned files; diagnosis can write temporary output.
guidance: Assign file ownership before implementation or transformation; diagnosis does not edit product source. Select Astra only for difficult architecture questions. Product Development owns these engineering agents.
